item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

item.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
item.description: The US calls its latest sanctions on Iran an "economic D-Day", but Tehran says it has a plan to counter them.

item.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
item.description: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
item.description: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

item.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
item.description: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.
